title: GET /log
description: Conversation read model. Tail snapshot, after_revision delta, or before paging share one shape. replace_required is absent on some missing:true responses, so it stays optional.

view.description: chat_view: the view this answer was read under when requested.

capped.description: true: the run goes on beyond what was counted (at most 100 messages, nearest the row)

hidden_before.description: hidden_coordination: rows left out since the previous visible row of the chat.

audience.description: Host contract 108: 'agents' for a row of a turn another agent's message started (coordination between agents); a note (kind 'note') is always 'user'.

view.description: chat_view: the view this row belongs to.

session_rows.description: chat_view: on a settled turn's anchor, the number of rows omitted by Conversation view.

sent_at.description: Host contract 115, feature waited_send_order: on a user row that waited for a running turn, when it was sent; its timestamp is when its own turn started.

turn.description: log_turn_summary: on a settled turn's last row, shaped like GET /live's turn.

coordination.description: hidden_coordination: the policy this answer was read under, present when the request named coordination.

capped.description: true: the run goes on beyond what was counted (at most 100 messages, nearest the row)

hidden_after.description: hidden_coordination: rows left out after the newest visible row.

last_message.description: The chat's line in the chat list, in English, without Markdown (contract 218).

last_message_preview.description: The chat list's line as a kind and its values, worded by the app in the user's language (Rust Host contract 218, feature chat_preview_parts; contract/fixtures/chat-preview.json).
